title: Bird Songs Visualized
content: Bird songs take on a whole new dimension when you see them visualized in a spectrogram. Time moves from left to right; higher pitches are higher up on the chart.Spectrogram of Ruby-crowned Kinglet song,Larimer County, CO, 6/1/2008 fromEarbirdingThe syrinx, or vocal chords, of many birds can make at least two tones at once.The following video has a sliding spectrogram matched to a song. (Link to YouTube)The best spectrograms are the freeMerlin Bird ID appproduced by theCornell Bird Academy
